payload.text: **ALL OF vc's INTENT WORK IS HELD UNTIL hv SAYS THE DEMO OF 2026-10-13 IS OVER (hv's word in vc's session, before vc's 08:47Z clock read).** hv, verbatim: "we're not touching _anything_ prior to today's demo".
